Main Ideas & Supporting Details
• Topic: 1 – 2 words telling us what the main focus is.
• Main Idea: A full sentence that will specifically state what the author wants to tell
the reader about the topic.
• Supporting Details: Facts and evidence that proves the author’s main point.

Main Idea
• The most important idea in the paragraph.
• The main message/what the writer is trying to tell
readers.
The main idea can be stated or implied.
The main idea can be found in the first few
sentences of the paragraph. Sometimes, it can be
found in the middle of the paragraph or in the last
sentence of the paragraph.
Stated: (Can be found in a sentence)
Implied: (Not directly stated)

Example
Having a pet can be good for you. The most common pets that people
keep are dogs and cats. Dogs are considered man’s best friends and cats are
considered a pirate’s first mate. However, they are both good company for all
mankind. Having a pet gives you something to focus on besides yourself. It
does not matter what kind of pet you choose, as long as you provide them with
love and care. Studies have shown that having a pet can also reduce stress. If
you’re an individual without a pet, go adopt one now and experience the joy
you’ve never felt before.

Now You Try
Protecting the Amazon rainforest is very important. The Amazon rainforest has been around
for 55 million years. It covers an enormous 6.7 million square kilometers and contains over 3
million different species of wildlife. All the animals that live in the Amazon may face
extinction if the rainforest is not preserved. In addition, around 76 billion tonnes of carbon is
stored in the Amazon rainforest. That means that the Amazon is helping with stabilizing the
Earth’s climate. The trees in the Amazon also release 20 billion tonnes of water into the
atmosphere per day, playing a critical role in global and regional carbon and water cycles.

Thesis Statement
• A thesis statement must be one sentence in length, no matter how
many clauses it contains. Clear writing is more important than rules
like these, so sometimes writers use two or three sentences if they
need them.
• A thesis statement must give three points of support. It should
indicate that the essay will explain and give evidence for its
assertion, but points don’t need to come in any specific number.

Article Title: WHY PROTECT THE AMAZON
Topic Sentence
Ancestral Homelands
Not only is the Amazon a biodiversity hotspot, but it is
also home to a wide range of indigenous groups. Over
400 tribes, each with a distinct culture, language, and
territory, continue to live in a largely traditional manner,
relying on these forests for their survival. Nearly 100 of
these tribes are “uncontacted” or in “voluntary
isolation,” and the forest offers their only protection.
Thesis Statement
The Amazon contains the single largest tropical rainforest
on the planet. Covering about 40% of the South American
continent, it spans more than 1.6 billion acres across nine
countries. Stretching east from the foothills of the Andes
Mountains, the upland glaciers, streams, and wetlands
feed the Amazon Rivers that wind all the way to the
Atlantic Ocean, creating the world’s largest river basin.
The Amazon’s forests and waters make it the most
important terrestrial biome on the planet, for it plays a
critical role in global and regional carbon and water cycles.
